description: One skill, one ledger, one sitting - and the one place the -next-goes-first rule runs backwards, because here the two wishes move the surface the held job builds on. janus-1 makes the gates read the manifest they already cite; janus-2 makes a manifest and the adapter it names agree before the suite runs; only then does janus-next add the second host adapter. Built in the other order, the second adapter is a second hand-written gate set beside a second unconsulted manifest.

title: Wave 12α — voice
description: Nothing downstream depends on these, so they absorb whatever slack is left. `sapheneia-next` builds the held cross-model corpus and reconciles the ten rules against it, which is the evidence the rest of the wave argues from. `sapheneia-2`'s canonical state block is then the grammar `brevitas-3`'s carve-out recognises and `sapheneia-1`'s pre-send checker enforces, in that order; `sapheneia-1` also borrows `brevitas-2`'s diagnostic schema from wave 4. `imprimatur-next` and `vulgate-next` are the two prose masks' own held jobs, neither carrying a wish on this list, and both are corpus and evaluation work that belongs beside sapheneia's.
